<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFBBCD"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="softPink" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F38093"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F88D9C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="716" fill="#F38093" opacity="0.18"/>

  <!-- animated-call visual field / fallback illustrated background -->
  <circle cx="54" cy="167" r="92" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.13"/>
  <circle cx="344" cy="250" r="126" fill="#F38093" opacity="0.22"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="563" r="118" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.20"/>
  <circle cx="352" cy="641" r="155" fill="#F88D9C" opacity="0.16"/>

    <circle cx="319" cy="122" r="12" fill="#FFD663"/>

    <polygon points="244,185 274,158 310,185" fill="#F38093"/>

    <polygon points="57,612 89,572 124,612" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="86,612 116,585 151,612" fill="#F38093"/>
    <circle cx="78" cy="563" r="9" fill="#FFD663"/>
  </g>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="28" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="900" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="322" y1="25" x2="322" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="25" x2="326" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="385" y="20" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="363" y="18" width="17" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>

  <text x="195" y="93" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="25px" font-weight="300" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
  <line x1="20" y1="112" x2="370" y2="112" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- call state -->
  <text x="195" y="145" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="900" fill="#FFFFFF">LIVE VOICE CALL</text>
  <circle cx="195" cy="263" r="105" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="257" r="92" fill="#F99DAA" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="5"/>
  <!-- bird avatar -->
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="276" rx="56" ry="42" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.88"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="218" r="39" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polygon points="228,220 263,232 228,244" fill="#FFD663"/>
  <circle cx="210" cy="211" r="5" fill="#000000"/>
  <polygon points="167,254 128,292 182,282" fill="#F38093"/>
  <polygon points="224,255 260,292 211,281" fill="#F38093"/>
  <circle cx="174" cy="232" r="4" fill="#F38093"/>
  <text x="195" y="387" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="28px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Maya Chen</text>
  <text x="195" y="414" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">00:12:48  •  Connected</text>

  <text x="195" y="450" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="900" fill="#F38093">HD AUDIO</text>

  <!-- control shadows -->
  <rect x="45" y="493" width="62" height="62" rx="31" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <g>

  <g>
    <rect x="303" y="489" width="42" height="62" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.92"/>
    <polygon points="312,518 319,518 328,510 328,530 319,523 312,523" fill="#F38093"/>

  <g>
    <rect x="124" y="615" width="142" height="58" rx="31" fill="#000000" opacity="0.20" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

    <line x1="151" y1="631" x2="167" y2="647" stroke="#F88D9C" stroke-width="4"/>

    <text x="210" y="646" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="17px" font-weight="900" fill="#FFFFFF">End Call</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="704" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Tap End Call when you're ready</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="84" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.94"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="760" x2="390" y2="760" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- Friends -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="39" cy="781" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="781" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="31" y1="795" x2="61" y2="795" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="46" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Friends</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Birds -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="112,778 128,786 112,794 96,786" fill="#F38093"/>
    <circle cx="113" cy="784" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="113" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Birds</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Map -->

    <polyline points="232,779 243,776 254,780 265,776 265,795 254,799 243,795 232,799 232,779" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

    <line x1="254" y1="780" x2="254" y2="799" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="248" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Map</text>
  </g>

    <circle cx="333" cy="786" r="15" fill="#F88D9C"/>
    <polyline points="327,780 324,783 327,789 332,793 338,795 341,792" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
